rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll_Sideloading {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common characteristics of Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs loaded via rundll32 from temp directories"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/"
        tlp = "amber"
        miter_ids = ["T1218.011", "T1055"]
    strings:
        $a = "beacon.dll" nocase
        $b = { 6A 00 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 0C } // Common API call pattern
        $c = "Start" fullword ascii
    condition:
        $a and $b and $c and filename matches /\\Temp\\.*\.dll$/i
}

rule GoldenTicket_TGT_Metadata {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Golden Ticket indicators in Kerberos TGT metadata"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1558.001"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $s1 = "krbtgt" wide ascii
        $s2 = "PAC_SIGNATURE" wide ascii
        $s3 = "AES256_CTS_HMAC_SHA1_96" wide ascii
        $x1 = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // Null PAC checksum (common in forged tickets)
    condition:
        all of ($s*) and $x1
}
